an4.39:1.1: Atha kho Ujjayo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.39:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Ujjāyo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.39:1.3: Bhavam pi no Gotamo yaññaṃ vaṇṇetīti? 2.
an4.39:1.4: Na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ yaññaṃ vaṇṇemi
an4.39:1.5: na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa sabbaṃ yaññaṃ na vaṇṇemi.
an4.39:1.6: Yathārūpe ca kho brāhmaṇa yaññe gāvo haññanti ajeḷakā haññanti kukkuṭasūkarā haññanti vividhā pāṇā saṅghātaṃ āpajjanti,
an4.39:1.7: evarūpaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa sārambhaṃ yaññaṃ na vaṇṇemi.
an4.39:1.9: Evarūpaṃ hi brāhmaṇa sārambhaṃ yaññaṃ na upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahamaggaṃ samāpannā vā.
an4.39:2.1: Yathārūpe ca kho brāhmaṇa yaññe n' eva gāvo haññati na ajeḷakā haññati na kukkuṭasūkarā haññati na vividhā pāṇā saṅghātaṃ āpajjanti,
an4.39:2.2: evarūpaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa nirārambhaṃ yaññaṃ vaṇṇemi yadidaṃ niccadānaṃ anukulayaññaṃ.
an4.39:2.4: Evarūpaṃ hi brāhmaṇa nirārambhaṃ yaññaṃ upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannāti. 3.
